This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Yes, it's deliberate: src/export/csv.ts prepends a UTF-8 byte order mark by default (`bom = true`) so spreadsheet apps detect the encoding correctly when a CSV is opened directly. The function does accept a `bom: false` option to omit it, but none of the current callers (src/api/reports.ts, src/export/scheduler.ts) expose that option, so today every exported CSV gets the BOM. Opening with `utf-8-sig` on your end is the right workaround; this behaviour is expected to stay unless we add a way to toggle it through the export API.
